name: agy
summary: When telemetry is on, the agy CLI collects usage data and sends it to Google to improve Antigravity. The toggle is saved with the signed-in account rather than in a local file, and business accounts have it off; a GitHub issue reports it is left on by default for the agy acp bridge.

optOut.instructions: In an agy session, open /settings or /config and turn off 'Enable Telemetry' (saved to your account). For the agy acp subcommand only, pass --disable_telemetry after 'acp' (as reported in the issue; confirm with 'agy acp --help').
